verification.independent_check: Separate standard-library arithmetic read the two raw JSONL files, joined physical frames and lifetime IDs, reconstructed FP32 current-point ownership, and checked native distance admission and sampled-center distances. No import of the audited analyzer for this independent calculation.
verification.source_review: Read fixed local native observation generation, replacement, sorting, talk2Env admission, recorder and radius initialization paths.

source_supported_findings.finding: Observation generation precedes end-goal Human replacement; talk2Env subsequently sorts current Human objects by actual center distance. The five recorded mismatch frames coincide with replacement. No radius-causality claim follows.

Wrapper spatial rows are sorted by observed relative distance, whereas talk2Env assigns them by all-human actual center distance. All observed current-point mismatches fail the native <0.1 gate and receive no native interval; the source returns zero conformity rows there. Actor-input tensors and counterfactual actions were not independently measured.
randomize_attributes=True invokes initial Human attribute sampling, including radius uniform(0.3,0.5); random_radii=False does not disable that call. Replacement invokes the same generator.
The active holonomic reset preserves robot radius 0.3. Human radii are not logged, so min(d)-0.8 <= minimum sampled surface clearance <= min(d)-0.6; this is a bound, not recovered radius draws.

accepted_limits: The 939 full-future same-ID checks reuse recorder attestations in issues.jsonl. This review did not reopen predictor NPZs or establish forecast accuracy, lifetime-history purity, or cross-entity noninterference beyond those recorded checks.
The 24 mismatches concern visible current-point ownership; identical invisible dummy rows have no uniquely inferred permutation.
The old 0.44927675174873716 is a fixed-0.3-radii proxy and an upper bound, not the measured physical minimum clearance. Last-bit differences reflect floating-point subtraction order.
The clearance bound covers recorded before/after positions only; it is not a swept-volume or between-sample collision certificate.
No modified ordering, actor counterfactual, repair, attack or real task harm was tested.
